## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the agent who made a certification — the WoT signer vouching for the key↔identity binding.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the identity the binding is about (that is [`gmeow:certifiedIdentity`](gmeow-certifiedIdentity.md)) and for the key vouched for ([`gmeow:certifiedKey`](gmeow-certifiedKey.md)); the certifier is who attests, not what is attested. It is functional — one certifier per certification.

### How to use

- Bind exactly one [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) as certifier; model a second signer's attestation as a separate [`gmeow:Certification`](../classes/gmeow-Certification.md) rather than a second certifier on the same one.
